tonight.headline: Tuten is cleared. Likely missing Friday is the new question
body: Bad news first: Isaiah Likely did not practise Friday (groin) and you have no other tight end. He carries no designation and Harbaugh calls it 'minor', so he starts, but if he is inactive at 13:55 Sunday the slot scores zero unless you add a tight end who plays Monday. The plan for that is in the lineup check.

The good news: Tuten got a limited practice Friday and is off Jacksonville's final report, and you moved Gordon in for Diggs at 13:54 today, so the lineup as set is the projection lineup. ESPN has you at 132.9 to 121.7 and 56%.

case.label: The script that beats you
case.body: Panda Attack start three Cowboys (Prescott 22.3, Javonte Williams 19.7, Pickens 15.8) in Titans–Cowboys at 12:00, where Dallas' implied total is about 31 (Rotowire), and Skattebo (14.5) plays at 15:25 against Tuten and Likely. A Dallas shootout plus a Likely zero is the losing script.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Likely inactive at 13:55 with no tight end added: about 13 projected points become zero. Tuten inactive is now a small risk: limited Friday, no designation.

case.label: What you did
case.body: At 19:54Z today you put Gordon in and benched Diggs (activity log). That is the projection lineup, 137.1. Gordon went into FLEX, though, and Tuten is still in an RB slot (slot column).

case.label: Why it matters less now
case.body: Tuten went limited on Friday and Jacksonville left him off the final report (PFT 20 Nov 21:16Z). He played the last two games on the same practice pattern (Rotoworld). The morning's ELITE card is downgraded to DEPTH.

case.label: Why it is still worth a minute
case.body: Every back you own locks at 12:00. Jacksonville's inactives come at 13:55. In FLEX, Tuten can be replaced by Waddle (DEN 15:25, off the report, PFT) or Diggs (Mon). In an RB slot he cannot. Points are the same either way.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Tuten is active, so the swap changes nothing (no harm). It is WRONG only if Tuten is inactive and the slot scores zero because Tuten was still in an RB slot.
